sentences.en: Sometimes hockey players get so competitive that fights break out.
sentences.zh: 有时候曲棍球运动员会因为竞争太激烈而打起来。

sentences.en: In hockey and soccer, goals are counted as points.
sentences.zh: 在曲棍球和足球中，进球会被计为得分。

sentences.en: I don't like such sports as boxing and hockey.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢拳击和曲棍球这类运动。
